baseline_models.focus_anchor: سَلَكَكُمْ with the locative construction فِي سَقَرَ and root س ل ك.
baseline_models.mechanism: The addressees are construed as travelers whose arrival in a bounded destination has a traversed course; مَا asks for the course or cause that carried them through.

activation_trace.role: Passing through a path supplies directed transit into the named destination.

changed_reading.after: What course did you travel that brought you into Saqar?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative مَا occupies the causal slot before transitive سَلَكَكُمْ, whose object is the addressed group.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question can foreground an inserting cause rather than autonomous motion: something made the group pass into a place or state.

activation_trace.role: Putting something into something supplies the external-cause frame for entry into Saqar.

changed_reading.after: What inserted you or caused you to pass into Saqar?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same focus root س ل ك carries a branch of direct forward thrust, while فِي fixes its endpoint.
baseline_models.mechanism: Entry is pictured as an aimed, unbending trajectory rather than accidental drift.

activation_trace.role: A straight thrust directly forward supplies the exploratory image of an aimed trajectory.

changed_reading.after: What set you on so direct a trajectory into Saqar?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root س ل ك also names sewing thread, and the transitive-plus-container construction can sustain an insertion image.
baseline_models.mechanism: A sequence of acts may be pictured as a strand that threads persons into a final enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Sewing thread supplies the material image of acts becoming a strand that fastens the group into a destination.

changed_reading.after: What strand of conduct threaded you into Saqar?

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier first-person announcement of making someone meet Saqar's fire supplies an external actor; the focus question then asks which causal condition or conduct issued in that announced insertion.

activation_trace.role: Insertion into a place or punishment anchors the focus question as causative entry.
Meeting fire and its heat makes the earlier naming of Saqar an enacted exposure rather than neutral location.

structural_cues: 74:26 first introduces the same destination in a first-person future threat.
74:42 shifts from that announced actor to an interrogative cause addressed to the occupants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an announced exposure to Saqar and later asks what inserted the group; I infer that their conduct mediates the announced act. Alternatively, مَا may simply request a list of deeds without foregrounding distributed agency.

changed_reading.before: What external cause inserted you into Saqar?
changed_reading.after: What did you make operative that rendered you liable to the announced exposure to Saqar?

context_deltas.mechanism: Will, guidance to a path, and the paired motions of advance and lag turn سلك from an undifferentiated road into a live directional axis on which a hearer takes position.

activation_trace.role: Path traversal anchors the focus as the endpoint of directional movement.
Will directed toward a thing supplies a volitional component in choosing movement.
Gentle indication toward a path or truth supplies a guided alternative to the ruinous route.
Advancing forward places the addressee on an explicit movement axis.
The rear or behind supplies the opposed direction on that same axis.

structural_cues: 74:37 addresses whoever wills to advance or lag before 74:38-42 disclose the two outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies willing, path-guidance, and advance-versus-lag; I infer that they frame the focus verb as route selection. A live alternative is that advance and lag mark moral rank or timing without a spatial contribution to سلك.

changed_reading.after: How did your response to guidance position and carry you along the advance-or-lag axis into Saqar?

context_deltas.mechanism: What a self acquires becomes the right by which it is held; the route into Saqar is therefore an accumulation-to-detention process rather than mere locomotion.

activation_trace.role: Insertion supplies the transition from accumulated conduct into a held destination.
Seeking and acquiring a gain supplies the accumulated product attributed to each self.
A security held against a right turns what was acquired into the mechanism of detention.

structural_cues: 74:38 states the earning-and-pledge rule immediately before the exception, garden dialogue, and focus question.
The replies in 74:43-46 unpack conduct after the general rule has supplied its causal frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acquisition followed by being held as a pledge; I infer an arrow from accumulated conduct to insertion and detention. Alternatively, the pledge statement may describe accountability generally without specifying how entry occurs.

changed_reading.before: What brought you into this place?
changed_reading.after: What did you accumulate that fixed you as collateral and thereby delivered you into Saqar?

context_deltas.mechanism: Mutual questioning in the gardens narrows into a direct inquiry addressed to offenders; the focus question functions as elicited testimony that makes the occupants expose their own causal history.

activation_trace.role: A traversed path gives the inquest its subject: the route by which the addressees reached Saqar.
Reciprocal questioning supplies the dialogic frame from which the direct question emerges.
Offense and wrongdoing identify the questioned group by culpable status before they answer.

structural_cues: 74:39-41 locate one group in gardens and mark the other as the questioned offenders.
The first-person-plural admissions of 74:43-47 answer the second-person-plural question directly.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal inquiry, a named offender group, and self-incriminating replies; I infer that the question stages diagnostic testimony rather than a request born of ignorance. It could alternatively remain an astonished ordinary inquiry.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified speaker asks why the group is there.
changed_reading.after: Those outside Saqar elicit an offender group's own account of the route that convicted and confined them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated being-in-a-state combines with entering discourse or an affair alongside others; prior collective immersion becomes the channel that eventually issues in collective entry into Saqar.

activation_trace.role: Traversing a path anchors the later destination as the terminus of an earlier channel.
A thing's occurring and being present in time supplies the admission's sustained habitual state.
Entering discourse or an affair supplies the social medium through which the group repeatedly moved.

structural_cues: 74:45 repeats the first-person-plural state marker and pairs the action with مَعَ and a matching agent plural.
The answer describes an earlier collective ingress in response to a question about the group's final ingress.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies habitual presence and entry into talk or an affair with others; I infer that social immersion is a channel feeding the final path. Alternatively, خوض may denote misconduct broadly without making sociality the causal medium.

changed_reading.after: Which repeated immersion with a group became the channel through which you arrived in Saqar?

context_deltas.mechanism: The coordinated replies turn singular مَا into a composite causal profile: absent worship, withheld sustenance, participatory immersion, and active denial of reckoning work cumulatively rather than naming one isolated trigger.

activation_trace.role: Insertion into a state or punishment lets multiple causes converge on one resulting placement.
Specified worship anchors the first admission as absence from a binding devotional practice.
Feeding another anchors the second admission as failure of material care.
Entering talk or an affair anchors positive participation in a collective current, beyond mere omission.
Attributing something to falsehood supplies deliberate rejection in the final admission.
Accounting and recompense supply the denied horizon that joins conduct to destination.

structural_cues: 74:43-46 form a four-part first-person-plural answer linked by repeated negation, state markers, and conjunctions.
74:47 closes the duration of that pattern with the arrival of certainty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coordinated omissions, participation, and denial; I infer a cumulative pipeline in which each element reinforces the others. A live alternative is that the replies are independent examples, any one of which answers the question without a required sequence.

changed_reading.before: What single cause inserted you into Saqar?
changed_reading.after: Which mutually reinforcing pattern of neglected worship and care, collective immersion, and denied reckoning inserted you into Saqar?

context_deltas.mechanism: Turning one's side from the reminder escalates into distancing and flight; placed after the Saqar dialogue, that outbound motion from warning becomes the present-tense beginning of an inbound route to Saqar.

activation_trace.role: Path traversal anchors the retrospective destination whose route is reenacted after the dialogue.
That which prompts remembrance supplies the warning from which the hearers orient away.
Turning one's side supplies the first directional reversal away from the reminder.
Drawing away and becoming distant intensifies the counter-movement.
Flight completes the kinetic sequence and makes avoidance look like a traveled route.

structural_cues: 74:49 resumes with another مَا-question immediately after the occupants' admissions and failed intercession.
74:50-51 render present aversion as a two-ayah flight simile.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies orientation away, distancing, and flight after the retrospective dialogue; I infer that current flight from warning rehearses the route into Saqar. Alternatively, the simile may characterize only the intensity of aversion, not its eventual destination.

changed_reading.before: What once brought those occupants into Saqar?
changed_reading.after: What are the present hearers fleeing such that escape from the reminder becomes the very route toward Saqar?

context_deltas.mechanism: The close couples willing remembrance with protection and covering from harmful effects; this activates an inverse mechanism to insertion, making the focus question expose a route that remained interruptible.

activation_trace.role: Insertion into punishment supplies the harmful transition for which the close offers counter-images.
Will attached to an object supplies uptake rather than passive exposure to the reminder.
Bringing something to presence after forgetting supplies the responsive act that can interrupt the route.
Placing oneself within protection supplies the inverse of being inserted into harm.
Covering an offense and protecting its bearer from its effect supplies repair after culpable conduct.

structural_cues: 74:54-56 repeat the reminder root and move from description to possible uptake.
The final clause places protection and forgiveness together after the warning sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies willing remembrance, protection, and covering from an offense's effect; I infer a counter-route capable of interrupting insertion. Alternatively, the final attributes may characterize God without specifying a procedural escape from the focus destination.

changed_reading.before: The question identifies an already completed entry.
changed_reading.after: The question also exposes which refused reminder left the entrants without the protective and reparative counter-route named at the close.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the noun-thread branch of س ل ك and supplies the stitching arrow rather than finding stitching stated in the ayah. It remains anchored in the focus root and in the packet's explicit garment-and-cleansing pair at 74:4. Downstream prose should present it only as a cross-domain material image, never as a lexical translation of سَلَكَكُمْ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sewing-thread branch B004 belongs to focus root س ل ك, and the focus verb places the addressed object into an enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Sewing thread supplies the material carrier that can fasten a sequence of acts into a final placement.
Garment, including its possible representation of the self, supplies the material field in which thread has a function.
Removal of dirt supplies an opening counteraction to the image of a defiled strand fastening the self into harm.

changed_reading.before: What path carried you into Saqar?
changed_reading.after: What uncleansed strand of practice stitched you into Saqar, in material contrast to the opening command to cleanse the garment?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses distinct branches within the packet's split ص ل ي/ص ل و mapping to juxtapose following a line, worship, and meeting fire. It remains anchored by the focus path/insertion root and by the explicit 74:26 and 74:43 occurrences. Render it as a packet-licensed sound-and-branch constellation, not as proof that the two contextual words have one contextual sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus س ل ك B001 asks about a traversed line into Saqar, permitting contextual images of following and fiery exposure to specify competing alignments.

activation_trace.role: Path traversal supplies the line whose alignment the question investigates.
Meeting fire supplies the terminal alignment explicitly tied to Saqar.
Following the leader in a race supplies the exploratory image of joining one line rather than another.

changed_reading.before: What route inserted you into Saqar?
changed_reading.after: Which line did you come to follow, when absence from the worshiping line is answered by being made to meet Saqar's fire?

strongest_changes: The path reading became an accumulation-to-detention mechanism under 74:38 and a cumulative answer pipeline under 74:43-46.
The repeated social ingress of خوض made collective participation a channel feeding the final ingress of سلك.
The post-dialogue turn and flight from reminder converted a retrospective question into a present diagnostic mirror.
The earlier announced exposure to Saqar sharpened the focus question's unresolved relation between external insertion and accountable conduct.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah sequence repeatedly converts orientation into outcome: guidance, advance or lag, earning, social immersion, interrogation, flight, and protective remembrance all alter what the compact focus verb can causally contain. The garment-thread and competing-lines activations remain useful precisely as contained branch-level outliers.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether مَا foregrounds an inserting agent, a causal set of deeds, or the manner of entry remains open.
The relative weight of human willing and divine guidance or insertion is activated but not resolved by the packet.
The cumulative ordering of the four admissions is inferred; the text may present parallel sufficient answers instead.
The sewing-thread and prayer/fire line models are branch-distant images and should not control ordinary rendering.
